lookup.rule: The atomic store locks and looks up the raw external request key so scope, actor, player, operation and target drift cannot create a second effect.

payloadRule: Object keys are sorted; array order is preserved; null, boolean, safe number, bigint and string have distinct type tags; proxies, unsupported prototypes, accessors, holes, symbols, undefined, unsafe integers, non-finite numbers, cycles and depth above 64 fail closed.
boundarySnapshotRule: Input, actor, receipt and result boundaries accept only exact plain data objects, arrays and canonical primitives. Each boundary is descriptor-snapshotted once before fingerprinting, comparison or return; proxies, accessors, symbols and noncanonical extra fields fail closed, including nested actor, player, target and result data.
atomicStoreRule: withLockedRequestKey must serialize the same requestKey and commit or roll back the business effect and terminal receipt together. Concrete database participant/outbox adoption belongs to RFA-02.

legacyCompatibility.CURRENCY_V1: Exact existing JSON tuple currencyId/deltaMinorAmount decimal string/operationKind/reasonKey only.
legacyCompatibility.FURNITURE_V1: Exact existing JSON array operationKind followed by operation-specific ordered string values only.
legacyCompatibility.APP_WIRING_V1: Exact existing request namespace/entrypoint/external id identity hash plus canonical normalized payload hash only.
notCompatible: canonical item inventory receipt without payload fingerprint
legacy operations result_json without a request fingerprint
legacyCompatibility.boundary: Legacy projectors validate only fields actually persisted by that version and never promote the receipt to complete RFA01 identity coverage.
